Thus we will write parameterized tests for groups: Valid Input Scenarios, Invalid Input Scenarios, Null/Exception, Custom Execution Context, URL Encoded Input Scenarios, Empty/Whitespace Input, Schema Constraint Violations, Custom Execution Context Edge Cases, Malformed YAML Input, Invalid Percent Encoding, Empty URL Encoded Input, Whitespace URL Encoded Input, Custom Execution Context Invalid Configuration.

But we can create a custom ExecutionContextCustomizer that captures the context into an array and then assert after call. The validate method will apply customizer before validation; we can capture it.
